capabilities: Annotate selected text with visual marks (highlight, underline, strikethrough, bold) and preset or custom colors
Write Markdown comments with pasted images in a standalone annotation editor
Manage annotations as cards in a sidebar view with search, sorting, and jump-to-text
Export annotations as a Markdown summary or as native Word comments in a .docx export
Relocate annotations after text edits and batch-clean orphaned ones
extras: Commands, settings, and most interface text are currently in Simplified Chinese only; support runs through a Simplified Chinese QQ group. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Annotation data is stored as per-note JSON inside the vault and the code makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach comments to text passages, and existing approaches insert extra syntax into the note itself.

relations.evidence: inspired by and references ideas from excellent open-source annotation and commenting plugins
SideNote — sidebar annotation management, comment organization, and interaction design

summary: Sidebar annotation plugin that marks selected text and attaches standalone Markdown comments without inserting syntax into the original note.
